page_title: CEL 1-2 OSA | Celta Vigo v Osasuna 06/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo) climbs highest in the box and sends a poor header miles over the crossbar. Very poor attempt.
90+1' The foul by Valentin Rosier (Osasuna) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Jose Munuera.
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.

89' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) gets on the end of a pass inside the box and produces a promising first-time shot towards the bottom right corner. His effort is blocked by Sergio Herrera with a brilliant diving save!
88' We are about to witness a subsitution. Moi Gomez (Osasuna) for Aimar Oroz.
88' It will be a substitution. Abel Bretones (Osasuna) is ready to enter the pitch as Raul Moro walks off.
87' Raul Moro (Osasuna) is adjudged offside.
86' Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar.
86' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
85' The corner is swung in but Celta Vigo can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

85' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play and Celta Vigo manage to earn a corner.
83' Claudio Giraldez has decided to substitute Fernando Lopez and he is replaced by Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo).
83' The referee signals a substitution. Jones El Abdellaoui (Celta Vigo) is brought on as a substitute for Sergio Carreira.
82' Celta Vigo fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
79' 1 - 2 GOAL! Alejandro Catena meets a cross inside the box and heads the ball across the goal, where Raul Garcia (Osasuna) lurks and pokes it into the back of the net. 1:2.
78' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
78' Asier Osambela (Osasuna) gets his head on the corner, but he can't find the target as his header flies high over the crossbar.
78' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Osasuna.
77' The attendance for today's match is 18705.
75' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Borja Iglesias as he is replaced by Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo).
75' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) goes for goal but he blazes his shot well over the top.
75' The resulting set piece from Celta Vigo is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
75' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
70' Ruben Garcia will be replaced by Asier Osambela (Osasuna).
70' Substitution. Ante Budimir will be replaced by Raul Garcia (Osasuna).
68' Raul Moro (Osasuna) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
67' Claudio Giraldez has decided to make a change. Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) replaces Hugo Alvarez.
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) replaces Javier Rueda.
66' Javier Rueda (Celta Vigo) cushions the ball on his chest then hits a first-time volley well wide of the left post from inside the box.
62' The ball breaks to Ante Budimir (Osasuna) after a scramble in the box, but his first-time effort is immediately blocked.
62' Osasuna take a short corner kick.
61' Celta Vigo work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

61' Javier Rueda (Celta Vigo) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Celta Vigo will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
58' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) poorly executes the free kick and the ball only hits the wall.
58' Jose Munuera has a clear sight and sees a foul from Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo). Osasuna win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
56' What was Javier Rueda (Celta Vigo) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
53' 1 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Sergio Herrera no chance!
52' Referee Jose Munuera is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Celta Vigo!
51' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Celta Vigo using VAR. Let's see what happens.
49' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) is going to take the penalty!
48' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) touches the ball with his hand inside the box! It's a penalty for Celta Vigo!
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
45+1' Jose Munuera shows a yellow card to Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) for a tough tackle.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' Valentin Rosier (Osasuna) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
43' Raul Moro (Osasuna) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.

39' Raul Moro (Osasuna) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.

35' 0 - 1 It's a goal! Ante Budimir (Osasuna) makes it 0:1. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Raul Moro and planted his close-range header into the left side of the goal. Ionut Radu was helpless.
35' Celta Vigo have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
35' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. Celta Vigo have a corner.
32' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) is penalised for a foul. Jose Munuera had a clear view and blows his whistle.
31' Flavien Boyomo is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Jorge Herrando (Osasuna).
30' The game is interrupted now, Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
29' A quickly taken corner by Osasuna.
27' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
25' A cross from a corner kick by Celta Vigo is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

25' Iker Munoz (Osasuna) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Jose Munuera with no other option than to blow for a foul.
23' Iker Munoz (Osasuna) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
19' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) tries an acrobatic volley inside the box that disappears way over the bar.
15' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) tries his luck but the attempt goes well wide of the right post.
15' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls it and sends it straight at Sergio Herrera, who makes a comfortable save.
12' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
6' Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but blazes it just over the crossbar.
5' Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
5' Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
5' The referee blows his whistle, Celta Vigo are awarded a corner kick.
5' Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Celta Vigo will take the kick-off.
Jose Munuera will officiate today.
